scope_caveat: Local optimum over the explicitly tested candidate pool only; not a mathematical or global proof of optimality.

authority.note: PASS covers only the 10 complete configurations in the pool: raw baseline, registry canonical export, preferred six, five-swap keeping Talisman of Creativity, six-swap with Withering Torment instead of Lightning Axe, six-swap with Magmakin Artillerist instead of Glint-Horn Buccaneer, the Pass C exact pairing (+Glint-Horn Buccaneer -Green Goblin, Revenant) inside the six and as a single swap on the baseline, the Ledger Shredder-over-Iron Monger seven-swap and the Putrid Imp-over-Demand Answers seven-swap. It also covers the named single-card contenders. They were judged with finite current-Oracle rules cases; bounded enumerations answering the Pass C requested measured tests (a finite library-bounded Dakmor Salvage + Tectonic Reformation + Surly Badgersaur trace with red cost, tapped-Treasure, Monument, graveyard-hate and optional-exile interruptions; a 20-cell Glint-Horn Buccaneer vs Green Goblin, Revenant vs Magmakin Artillerist grid; exact lands-only colour access for {1}{U}{B}{R} and RRR plus a graveyard-independent outlet count); Commander Spellbook combo lookups (1 included combo in both lists, finite here); and a quantity-counted mana comparison. Tests run locally and in .github/workflows/m7-doctor-doom-king-of-latveria.yml; run URLs are recorded in the PR body. There is no statistical multiplayer ranking, no matched-opening playtest sample and no removal-response rate. The A/B seals and the owner-equivalent Pass C (final disposition NEEDS TESTING; genuinely independent third model not executed) are historical, baseline-scoped and not technically independent. Nothing here implies owner approval, M6 certification, M7 approval or a canonical change.
